sections.title: Recorded incident
sections.note: Internal record. Confirm impact and recovery evidence before sharing.
sections.sql: select field, value from tickets r cross join lateral (values ('reference',r.reference::text), ('name',r.name::text), ('requester',r.requester::text), ('owner',r.owner::text), ('status',r.status::text), ('opened at',r.opened_at::text), ('response due',r.response_due::text), ('resolve due',r.resolve_due::text), ('resolution',r.resolution::text)) v(field,value) where r.id=$1

sections.title: Activity
sections.sql: select actor,action,note,created_at from activity where entity_type='tickets' and entity_id=$1 order by created_at,id

sections.title: Plan and decision
sections.note: An approval record does not execute infrastructure changes.
sections.sql: select field, value from changes r cross join lateral (values ('reference',r.reference::text), ('name',r.name::text), ('owner',r.owner::text), ('risk',r.risk::text), ('scheduled at',r.scheduled_at::text), ('plan',r.plan::text), ('rollback',r.rollback::text), ('evidence',r.evidence::text), ('status',r.status::text), ('approved by',r.approved_by::text), ('approval note',r.approval_note::text), ('outcome',r.outcome::text)) v(field,value) where r.id=$1

sections.title: Related open incidents
sections.sql: select t.reference,t.name,t.priority,t.owner from tickets t join changes c on c.service_id=t.service_id where c.id=$1 and t.status in ('open','pending')

sections.title: Recorded custody
sections.sql: select field, value from assets r cross join lateral (values ('reference',r.reference::text), ('name',r.name::text), ('custodian',r.custodian::text), ('status',r.status::text), ('warranty on',r.warranty_on::text), ('review on',r.review_on::text), ('disposal evidence',r.disposal_evidence::text)) v(field,value) where r.id=$1

sections.title: Incident history
sections.sql: select reference,name,status,resolution from tickets where asset_id=$1 order by opened_at
